name: Labyrinth Bronze
description: A curl of green bronze pried from a wall that was somewhere else a moment ago.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Fae Dewglass
description: A drop of dew that never evaporates, hard as glass and faintly singing.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Hydra Scale
description: A green scale the size of a palm. Cut it, and two smaller scales grow from the wound.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Gorgon Tear
description: A tear that turned to stone as it fell. Ground fine, it cures stiffness of the joints, and of the heart.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Abyssal Pearl
description: A black pearl, cold as deep water. Hold it to your ear and you hear a bell.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Phoenix Cinder
description: An ember that never goes out. It is warm in your pocket, and sometimes it hums.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Dragon Scale
description: A scale like a shield of black glass. It is warm from the inside.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Brass Cog
description: A fine-toothed cog, still warm. It turns by itself if you set it on a table.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Golem Core Fragment
description: A shard of the crystal that animates war golems. It still twitches.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Aether Coil
description: A coil of glass-wrapped copper from a skyship engine. It floats a finger's width above your palm.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Data Crystal
description: A crystal shard full of tiny moving lights. If you stare long enough, you see someone else's memory.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Storm Capacitor
description: A glass jar full of trapped lightning. It cracks and pops if you shake it.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Reactor Slag
description: A lump of green-glowing slag. Alchemists will pay for it. Doctors will tell you not to carry it in your pocket.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Ectoplasm
description: A cold, faintly glowing jelly scraped off a haunted wall. It slowly creeps back toward where it came from.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Hag's Charm
description: A knot of hair, twine and a single bird skull. It is warm, and it tightens if you lie near it.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Haunted Porcelain
description: A shard of a doll's face. One painted eye is still open, and you're sure it blinked.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Plague Ash
description: Grey ash from the asylum furnace. Alchemists use it for cures. The System warns: HANDLE WITH CARE.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Silvered Shard
description: A shard of a haunted mirror. Your reflection in it is a heartbeat late.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Cracked Bell Bronze
description: A fragment of a cathedral bell. It rings faintly when it's near the dead.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Heartstone Chip
description: A chip of living stone that is slowly growing moss.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Ember Ore
description: A lump of ore that glows from within. Smiths would love to work it, if they can get it hot enough.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Tide Pearl
description: A pearl that is always wet. It gets heavier at high tide.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Everfrost Shard
description: A shard of ice that never melts. It burns cold to the touch.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Thunderbird Feather
description: A long feather that crackles with static. It points north, always.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Void Essence
description: A drop of nothing in a glass vial. It is heavier than it should be, and colder.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Redcap Insignia
description: A crude tin badge in the shape of a cap, stained red. The village guard pays a bounty on them.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Glowcap Spore Sac
description: A sac of luminous spores. It glows brighter when you are happy.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Royal Jelly
description: A golden, sweet jelly from the hive. It's said to make a person strong.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Star Metal
description: A nugget of metal that fell from the sky. It's lighter than it should be.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Chronoshard
description: A shard of frozen time. It is cold, and when you hold it, your heartbeat slows.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Seraph Feather
description: A feather of pure white light. It is warm, and holding it makes you feel watched, kindly.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.

name: Dream Ichor
description: A drop of black ichor from the Abyss. Hold it while you sleep and you'll dream of somewhere else.
flavor_text: The System lists it under GATE MATERIALS.
